title: SFX -- wicks change hands (purse)
_note: Wicks paid or received (shop counter buy/sell, a found purse, a quest reward, the pay op): a soft harp pluck into a small bell 'tuck' -- warmer and smaller than the pickup chirp. ~0.25 s. Render --tail 0.12 to .wav, then ffmpeg -af volume=-4dB -> .mp3.
